{{Quote|Doctor Lorrick is brilliant, arrogant, ambitious and completely amoral. He fled the Tion Hegemony decades ago after being declared a traitor. Been hiding out on Ord Mantell ever since.|[[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Rannos]]|<ref name="TOR:OinTH" />}}
Doctor '''Sannus Lorrick''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We suspect his ambitions go beyond the Tion Hegemony. He hungers for total galactic dominance. Kaon and the other worlds were just a test, a way for Lorrick to study the effects of the modified rakghoul virus he developed.|[[Darth Nurin]]|<ref name="TOR:TinTH">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Trouble in the Tion Hegemony|Vaiken Spacedock}}</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] native of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] who held the position of [[Royal Science Advisor]] in the decades before the [[Galactic War]], Lorrick carried out illegal experiments in viral modification and gene splicing for almost a decade before being discovered. The fifteen specimens that were still alive in his [[Sannus Lorrick's personal lab|labs]] were so altered that it could not be proven that they had been members of any [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], so he was largely acquitted and exiled from the Hegemony instead of being imprisoned.<ref name="Codex" /> Lorrick vowed revenge and eventually began experimenting on the [[rakghoul]] virus in his [[Lost Island|laboratory]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="TOR:OinTH" /> With his assistants [[Doctor/Legends|Doctors]] [[Asirr]], [[Evad]], [[Addy Ingrol]], and [[Tarkom]]<ref name="Lost Island" />&mdash;who all believed that he was searching for a [[Rakghoul serum|cure]]&mdash;Lorrick manipulated the virus and increased its capacity to cross the species barrier. <ref name="TOR:OinTH" />

Finally, in [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Lorrick hired a series of pilots to carry infected creatures to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the Hegemony,<ref name="TOR:KUS" /> and his gift of an infected [[risp]] to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zama Brak]] led to the destruction of the ''[[Stardream]]'' and an [[Rakghoul pandemic|outbreak]] on the desert planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Rakghoul 5">{{TORcite|type=codex|Rakghoul Pandemic: 5 - Origins of the Outbreak}}</ref> As four Tionese planets fell to the rakghoul virus, the pilot [[Melarra]] unknowingly aided Lorrick by [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|spreading]] the plague to [[Kaon]].<ref name="TOR:KUS" /> By this point, his obsession with the virus grew to the point where he became convinced that it was evolution perfected, and made it his mission to spread it across the entire galaxy. However, Ingrol and the other assistants discovered Lorrick's true plans and attempted to stop him. While managed to destroy his research, they were infected with the virus and placed under his control.<ref name="Lost Island" />

Lorrick later was [[Mission to the Lost Island|confronted]] by a strike team sent to eliminate him after his role in the Tion outbreak was discovered. To buy time for the perfected strain he had injected himself with to take effect, Lorrick offered to transform them with the rakghoul virus but was turned down. Subsequently, the virus took effect and caused Lorrick to painfully transform, before he did battle with the strike team. However, partway through the battle, Lorrick began to feel his body transform again and futilely protested the impossibility, shortly before he became a massive and mindless rakghoul. But even his new savage form was not enough to prevent his [[Death/Legends|death]] at the strike team's hands.<ref name="Lost Island" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Lorrick was introduced in the 2011 Star Wars MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the game update 1.2 "Legacy" being a part of the "Rise of the Rakghouls" Story arc, as well as the 2012 World event, the [[Rakghoul pandemic]]. Both Republic and Imperial players can confront and defeat him in the Flashpoint "Lost Island".
